correctness.rationale: The joint post-crossing state is always vacancy at n−1 and gate ON. The strong Markov property gives iid complete intervals, not an ordinary forward waiting time from a stationary observation epoch. The next m ungated jumps form an independent rate-one Erlang traversal S. Put a=(1−p)κ, b=pκ; the two-state killed service generator yields φ_ON=r(s+b)/Q and φ_OFF=rb/Q for Q=s²+(r+κ)s+rb. Weighting by p+(1−p)e^(−κS) and integrating gives exactly Φ. From ΦQ=N, −Φ′(0)=(Q′−N′)/(rb) and Φ″(0)=(N″−2+2μQ′)/(rb), recovering both displayed moments. The extra term in μ is (1−p)/p times the strictly decreasing integral m∫₀¹(1+κv)^(−m−1)dv. Renewal reward and particle conservation give equal current on all bonds; the counting variance rate is Var(τ)/μ³, including the stationary delayed process since the finite phase-type times have exponential moments. At small κ the numerator of the second moment tends to 2r(m+1/r)(1−p)/p and μ→(m+1/r)/p. At large κ the same moment formulas give μ→m+1/(rp) and Var(τ)→m+(rp)^(−2), not merely convergence in distribution. The fast Fano factor is strictly below one, so continuity with the divergent slow end proves existence (not uniqueness) of a finite crossing. Independent exact replay: python3 /workspace/branches/independent_checks.py 1 solves stationary and tilted-generator Poisson equations; it matches the current and Fano factor at three rational instances, from F≈13.114 at κ=1/30 to F≈0.149 at κ=51. The frozen checker was read, not run. Its printed 96 tally counts four categories per parameter point, although the Laplace category has two frequency equality assertions; this bookkeeping does not affect the proof.

evidence: Gated-network reaction theory reduces the first gated reaction transform to ungated passage/return transforms and switching kinetics, and reacts instantly at an overlapping reactive target. The physical vacancy at the prepared bond still has a finite hop rate when ON.

Dynamic-defect rings with occupancy-coupled closure and roadblocks across sites are not the single autonomous gated edge. The reviewed exact or approximate current-density passages do not give its speed dependence or noise.

evidence: Resetting the clock after an ON contact and using gamma first traversal followed by bond attempts gives the same conditional service transform. At a blocked contact the memoryless attempt process supplies a new Exp(r) return; successful contacts regenerate only because there is a single vacancy and a two-state autonomous gate.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Credit the first-reaction transform as closely reducible to prior gated-renewal machinery. Neither those first-reaction results nor the other Fano crossover establishes the full fixed-p speed comparison, coefficient 2(1−p)/(m+1/r), and positive slow-current/sub-Poisson fast-current noise boundary for this model. They follow here by the analytic moment comparison.

evidence: An independent Poisson attempt clock of rate r at the prepared bond, ignoring attempts when OFF, has the same successful-hop law as a rate-r ON clock. For this encoding the first contact time is S+Exp(r) and after a failed contact the return time is Exp(r).
Resultary 905b0ac177e0 instead has a two-site open process with pausing particles and a Fano peak/threshold in its pausing parameters.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: On the vacancy path itself the blocked hop is gate-dependent, but on the encoded attempt path contacts are independent until the first ON success. This is a point-contact (zero target holding) version of the earlier gated reaction construction and recovers the interval transform by a two-state renewal sum. The pausing model is not related by changing gate rates or ring size.

originality.rationale: Pass for the combined one-vacancy current and counting-noise law, including fixed-open-fraction speed monotonicity and the slow Fano prefactor. Gated reaction renewal is prior and even admits a close reduction of the interval law via independent bond attempt times as instantaneous contacts. The closest inspected exclusion formulas and catalogued Fano crossover do not cover this generator and statistic together. Neither a new general renewal method nor priority over all gated-service models is claimed.
residual_risks: Historical Markov-modulated queues, gated-service or traffic-light calculations may have an equivalent speed/variance law. No such result was established by the bounded searches.
A difference in physical path generators does not by itself establish transform originality: the point-contact encoding recovers the gated interval calculation.

value.rationale: Transmission current alone would suggest throughput remains regular as the gate slows, whereas its asymptotic count variance becomes very large. The positive limiting current, sharp noise coefficient, and forced approach to sub-Poisson noise supply an exact benchmark where effective-rate averaging loses important information. This is useful in the single-vacancy sector and does not claim a general-density law or a unique crossover.
